// Standard-library-only offline AST extraction. Never executes Loki or Pulse.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"
const testPath = "pkg/util/server/error_classify_test.go"

type object map[string]any
type source struct {
	path string
	data []byte
	fs   *token.FileSet
	file *ast.File
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func check(ok bool, msg string) {
	if !ok {
		panic(msg)
	}
}
func hash(b []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(b)) }
func (s source) code(n ast.Node) string {
	return string(s.data[s.fs.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:s.fs.Position(n.End()).Offset])
}
func (s source) record(n ast.Node) object {
	return object{"source": s.path, "lines": []int{s.fs.Position(n.Pos()).Line, s.fs.Position(n.End()).Line}, "original_go": s.code(n)}
}
func (s source) declaration(n ast.Node) object {
	p := s.record(n)
	text := s.code(n) + "\n"
	p["original_go"], p["sha256"] = text, hash([]byte(text))
	return p
}
func load(root, path, want string) source {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path)))
	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
		b, err = exec.Command("git", "-C", root, "show", revision+":"+path).Output()
	}
	must(err)
	check(hash(b) == want, "source SHA-256 mismatch: "+path)
	fs := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fs, path, b, parser.ParseComments)
	must(err)
	return source{path, b, fs, f}
}

// The resolver accepts only original literal wants, named constants, and the
// original validation-message fmt.Sprintf calls. Error inputs stay symbolic.
type resolver struct {
	values       map[string]any
	declarations []object
}

func (r *resolver) value(s source, e ast.Expr) any {
	switch n := e.(type) {
	case *ast.BasicLit:
		switch n.Kind {
		case token.STRING:
			v, err := strconv.Unquote(n.Value)
			must(err)
			return v
		case token.INT:
			v, err := strconv.Atoi(n.Value)
			must(err)
			return v
		}
	case *ast.Ident, *ast.SelectorExpr:
		if v, ok := r.values[s.code(e)]; ok {
			return v
		}
	case *ast.CallExpr:
		check(s.code(n.Fun) == "fmt.Sprintf" && len(n.Args) == 3, "unknown expectation call: "+s.code(e))
		name := s.code(n.Args[0])
		check(name == "validation.ErrMaxEntriesLimit" || name == "validation.ErrQueryTooLong", "unknown format template")
		format := r.value(s, n.Args[0]).(string)
		if name == "validation.ErrMaxEntriesLimit" {
			return fmt.Sprintf(format, r.value(s, n.Args[1]).(int), r.value(s, n.Args[2]).(int))
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf(format, r.value(s, n.Args[1]).(string), r.value(s, n.Args[2]).(string))
	}
	panic("unknown expectation: " + s.code(e))
}
func (r *resolver) bind(s source, name, symbol string) {
	found := 0
	for _, d := range s.file.Decls {
		g, ok := d.(*ast.GenDecl)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		for _, spec := range g.Specs {
			v, ok := spec.(*ast.ValueSpec)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			for i, id := range v.Names {
				if id.Name == name {
					check(len(v.Names) == len(v.Values), "implicit declaration")
					value := r.value(s, v.Values[i])
					r.values[symbol] = value
					p := s.record(v)
					p["symbol"], p["value"], p["source_sha256"] = symbol, value, hash(s.data)
					r.declarations = append(r.declarations, p)
					found++
				}
			}
		}
	}
	check(found == 1, "missing or duplicate constant: "+symbol)
}
func assertions(s source, n ast.Node) []object {
	out := []object{}
	ast.Inspect(n, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
		if !ok {
			return true
		}
		name := s.code(c.Fun)
		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "require.") || name == "t.Fatalf" {
			out = append(out, s.record(c))
		}
		return true
	})
	return out
}
func main() {
	check(len(os.Args) == 2, "usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki")
	files := map[string]source{}
	sources := []object{}
	for _, spec := range []struct{ path, hash string }{
		{testPath, "3629f2a42093f4b92d6ee4169095b3b8cd562175f9c17cad8aa3b748fd98cc3e"},
		{"pkg/util/server/error.go", "5ada39308f1f1a5f7c43918d92e13e854a50d3dbe35c08348a39db29ffd7f85e"},
		{"pkg/util/validation/validate.go", "f25baad77b4c96f00585209c90d8dec7be92ac5150fce7dfe4b861c302ba3672"},
	} {
		s := load(os.Args[1], spec.path, spec.hash)
		files[spec.path] = s
		sources = append(sources, object{"source": spec.path, "sha256": hash(s.data)})
	}
	r := resolver{values: map[string]any{}, declarations: []object{}}
	for _, name := range []string{"FailureTimeout", "FailureCanceled", "FailureThrottled", "FailureLimit", "FailureSyntax", "FailureBlocked", "FailureUserError", "FailureInternal"} {
		r.bind(files["pkg/util/server/error.go"], name, name)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"ErrMaxEntriesLimit", "ErrQueryTooLong"} {
		r.bind(files["pkg/util/validation/validate.go"], name, "validation."+name)
	}
	stdlib := object{"http.StatusBadRequest": http.StatusBadRequest, "http.StatusTooManyRequests": http.StatusTooManyRequests, "http.StatusInternalServerError": http.StatusInternalServerError, "http.StatusGatewayTimeout": http.StatusGatewayTimeout}
	for k, v := range stdlib {
		r.values[k] = v
	}
	s := files[testPath]
	functions := map[string]*ast.FuncDecl{}
	for _, d := range s.file.Decls {
		if f, ok := d.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok {
			check(functions[f.Name.Name] == nil, "duplicate function")
			functions[f.Name.Name] = f
		}
	}
	check(len(functions) == 4, "unexpected supporting/test functions")
	selections := []object{}
	rows := []object{}
	paths := []object{}
	for _, spec := range []struct {
		name   string
		count  int
		fields []string
	}{
		{"TestClassifyFailure", 22, []string{"name", "err", "wantCategory", "wantReason"}},
		{"TestWrappedLimitErrorStatusPreserved", 3, []string{"name", "sentinel", "status", "msg"}},
	} {
		f := functions[spec.name]
		check(f != nil && len(f.Body.List) == 1, "missing complete table")
		loop := f.Body.List[0].(*ast.RangeStmt)
		table := loop.X.(*ast.CompositeLit)
		check(len(table.Elts) == spec.count && len(loop.Body.List) == 1, "unexpected row/path count")
		fields := table.Type.(*ast.ArrayType).Elt.(*ast.StructType).Fields.List
		check(len(fields) == 4, "unexpected field count")
		for i, want := range spec.fields {
			check(len(fields[i].Names) == 1 && fields[i].Names[0].Name == want, "unexpected fields")
		}
		call := loop.Body.List[0].(*ast.ExprStmt).X.(*ast.CallExpr)
		check(s.code(call.Fun) == "t.Run" && len(call.Args) == 2 && s.code(call.Args[0]) == "tc.name", "unknown execution")
		p := s.record(loop.Body.List[0])
		p["table"], p["assertions"] = spec.name, assertions(s, call.Args[1])
		paths = append(paths, p)
		names := map[string]bool{}
		for _, e := range table.Elts {
			lit := e.(*ast.CompositeLit)
			check(len(lit.Elts) == 4, "unknown row")
			name := r.value(s, lit.Elts[0]).(string)
			check(!names[name], "duplicate name")
			names[name] = true
			row := s.record(lit)
			row["table"], row["name"] = spec.name, name
			if spec.name == "TestClassifyFailure" {
				row["input"] = object{"error_expression": s.code(lit.Elts[1])}
				row["expected_expressions"] = object{"category": s.code(lit.Elts[2]), "reason": s.code(lit.Elts[3])}
				row["expected"] = object{"category": r.value(s, lit.Elts[2]), "reason": r.value(s, lit.Elts[3])}
			} else {
				row["input"] = object{"sentinel_expression": s.code(lit.Elts[1]), "status_expression": s.code(lit.Elts[2]), "message_expression": s.code(lit.Elts[3]), "operation": "wrapLimit(tc.sentinel, tc.status, tc.msg)"}
				row["expected_expressions"] = object{"status": "tc.status", "body": "tc.msg", "error_is": "tc.sentinel"}
				row["expected"] = object{"status": r.value(s, lit.Elts[2]), "body": r.value(s, lit.Elts[3]), "error_is_expression": s.code(lit.Elts[1])}
			}
			row["upstream_execution_count"] = 1
			rows = append(rows, row)
		}
		selection := s.declaration(f)
		selection["table"], selection["row_count"], selection["upstream_subtest_execution_count"] = spec.name, spec.count, spec.count
		selections = append(selections, selection)
	}
	// Preserve the prefix test as relational constraints, never as fabricated
	// literal prefix outputs. Only the original input ReplaceAll operations run.
	f := functions["TestPrefixBeforeFormat"]
	check(f != nil, "missing prefix test")
	selection := s.declaration(f)
	selection["table_row_count"], selection["test_body_execution_count"] = 0, 1
	selections = append(selections, selection)
	assign := f.Body.List[0].(*ast.AssignStmt)
	check(s.code(assign.Lhs[0]) == "templates", "missing template map")
	templates := assign.Rhs[0].(*ast.CompositeLit)
	check(len(templates.Elts) == 2, "incomplete template inputs")
	inputs := []object{}
	constraints := []object{}
	for _, e := range templates.Elts {
		kv := e.(*ast.KeyValueExpr)
		name := r.value(s, kv.Key).(string)
		tmpl := r.value(s, kv.Value).(string)
		p := s.record(kv)
		p["name"], p["template_expression"], p["template"], p["message"] = name, s.code(kv.Value), tmpl, strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ReplaceAll(tmpl, "%s", "x"), "%d", "1")
		inputs = append(inputs, p)
		for _, predicate := range []string{"require.NotEmpty(t, prefix)", "require.NotContains(t, prefix, \"%\")", "require.True(t, matchesTemplate(msg, tmpl))"} {
			constraints = append(constraints, object{"input": name, "original_assertion_shape": predicate})
		}
	}
	for _, a := range inputs {
		for _, b := range inputs {
			if a["name"] != b["name"] {
				constraints = append(constraints, object{"input": a["name"], "other_input": b["name"], "original_assertion_shape": "require.False(t, matchesTemplate(msg, otherTmpl))"})
			}
		}
	}
	constraints = append(constraints, object{"inputs": []string{inputs[0]["name"].(string), inputs[1]["name"].(string)}, "relation": "distinct prefixes", "original_guard": "if other, ok := seen[prefix]; ok", "original_failure": "t.Fatalf(\"templates %q and %q share the prefix %q\", name, other, prefix)"})
	control := []object{}
	for _, stmt := range f.Body.List[len(f.Body.List)-2:] {
		c := stmt.(*ast.ExprStmt).X.(*ast.CallExpr)
		p := s.record(c)
		constraints = append(constraints, p)
		control = append(control, p)
	}
	check(len(constraints) == 11 && len(assertions(s, f)) == 7, "incomplete prefix constraints")
	// Enumerate the verb-first input from its AST, not an implementation output.
	last := f.Body.List[len(f.Body.List)-1].(*ast.ExprStmt).X.(*ast.CallExpr)
	match := last.Args[1].(*ast.CallExpr)
	verbInput := object{"message": r.value(s, match.Args[0]), "template": r.value(s, match.Args[1]), "assertions": control}
	prefix := object{"name": f.Name.Name, "inputs": inputs, "verb_first_control": verbInput, "operations_and_assertions_original_go": s.code(f.Body), "assertion_sites": assertions(s, f), "constraints": constraints, "constraint_count": 11, "require_assertion_execution_count": 10, "uniqueness_guard_evaluation_count": 2, "fatal_call_count_on_success": 0, "test_body_execution_count": 1, "map_iteration_order": "unspecified; source declaration order is used only to enumerate inputs"}
	wrap := functions["wrapLimit"]
	check(wrap != nil, "missing wrapLimit")
	out := object{"schema_version": 1, "revision": revision, "sources": sources, "selections": selections, "supporting_declarations": []object{s.declaration(wrap)}, "resolved_constants": r.declarations, "standard_library_status_constants": stdlib, "execution_paths": paths, "rows": rows, "row_count": 25, "classification_row_count": 22, "wrapped_limit_row_count": 3, "upstream_subtest_execution_count": 25, "prefix_constraints": prefix, "upstream_top_level_test_count": 3, "upstream_require_assertion_execution_count": 63}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	must(enc.Encode(out))
}
